sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日简报《DealBook》负责商业和政策报道。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的DealBook峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最有影响力的人物，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zilran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼等许多人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的对话实况。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch, free, at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在nytimes.com上直播部分精选采访，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅用户，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得一个月的免费阅读权限，畅享我们所有的报道。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: Today, hotels, massages, threats.
sentences.zh: 今天的话题：酒店、按摩、威胁。

sentences.en: More and more women are coming forward with their stories of harassment, assault, and worse by Harvey Weinstein.
sentences.zh: 越来越多的女性站出来，讲述她们遭受哈维·韦恩斯坦骚扰、侵犯甚至更严重伤害的经历。

sentences.en: And we hear one of those stories.
sentences.zh: 接下来我们将听到其中一个故事。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, October 11th.
sentences.zh: 今天是10月11日，星期三。

sentences.en: Jodi Kanter, thank you for coming back.
sentences.zh: 乔迪·坎特，感谢你再次来到节目中。

sentences.en: It's great to be back with you.
sentences.zh: 很高兴能再次与你交流。

sentences.en: The last time you were here, you told us about a pattern of sexual harassment allegations that you discovered against Harvey Weinstein, the Hollywood producer.
sentences.zh: 你上次来的时候，向我们讲述了你所发现的针对好莱坞制片人哈维·韦恩斯坦的一系列性骚扰指控。

sentences.en: What have you learned since then?
sentences.zh: 从那以后你又了解到了什么？

sentences.en: So the first story had a really positive effect journalistically, which is that people became more willing to speak.
sentences.zh: 第一篇报道在新闻界产生了非常积极的影响，那就是人们变得更愿意发声了。

sentences.en: And, you know, all summer I have been telling my sources the dynamic is going to reverse.
sentences.zh: 你知道，整个夏天我一直在告诉我的消息来源，这种态势将会逆转。

sentences.en: If these allegations are true, if these allegations continue to pile up, all of the sort of fear that you've experienced over the years, you know,
sentences.zh: 如果这些指控属实，如果这些指控继续堆积，那么你们多年来所经历的那种恐惧，你知道，

sentences.en: the feeling that these things could not be talked about, if these allegations are what we think they are, then you are going to hear a lot more people coming forward.
sentences.zh: 那种觉得这些事情无法启齿的感觉，如果这些指控正如我们所想的那样，那么你将会听到更多人站出来。

sentences.en: And so essentially, that's what happened.
sentences.zh: 本质上，事情就是这样发展的。

sentences.en: We began to see in different news outlets, people were coming out of the woodwork and telling Harvey Weinstein stories.
sentences.zh: 我们开始在不同的新闻媒体上看到，人们纷纷现身，讲述关于哈维·韦恩斯坦的故事。

sentences.en: The New Yorker published a really powerful article documenting assault allegations in addition to some very disturbing stories of sexual harassment.
sentences.zh: 《纽约客》发表了一篇非常有力的文章，记录了除了一些令人不安的性骚扰故事外，还有针对他的侵犯指控。

sentences.en: And then today, we published a story describing specifically the casting couch allegations in terms of how he treated actresses.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们发表了一篇报道，具体描述了他在对待女演员方面的“试镜沙发”指控。

sentences.en: Is this, Jodi, an instance where women who were scared to tell their story now feel like it's safer to do that?
sentences.zh: 乔迪，这是不是意味着那些曾经害怕讲述自己故事的女性，现在觉得这样做更安全了？

sentences.en: That's what they've told us.
sentences.zh: 她们就是这么告诉我们的。

sentences.en: The name people mention again and again to me is Ashley Judd.
sentences.zh: 人们反复向我提到的名字是阿什莉·贾德。

sentences.en: For some of the women who we've spoken to in the past couple of days,
sentences.zh: 对于我们在过去几天里交谈过的一些女性来说，

sentences.en: the fact that such a major Hollywood star was willing to come forward in the newspaper and describe her experience was really powerful for them.
sentences.zh: 一位如此重量级的好莱坞明星愿意在报纸上站出来描述她的经历，这对她们来说非常有力量。

sentences.en: And then what was even more powerful is that because, at least according to the stories we've heard, Weinstein used the same techniques and the same manipulation again and again.
sentences.zh: 更具力量的是，至少根据我们听到的故事，韦恩斯坦反复使用相同的手段和操纵方式。

sentences.en: Sometimes when I've been doing interviews in the last couple of days, women have said to me, oh, just like in the Ashley Judd story, he da-da-da-da-da-da-da.
sentences.zh: 有时我在过去几天做采访时，女性会对我这样说：哦，就像阿什莉·贾德的故事里那样，他做了这样那样的事。

sentences.en: So that's become like a real lodestar for them.
sentences.zh: 所以这已经成为了她们真正的指路明灯。

sentences.en: Can you describe that system to us that Ashley Judd described and that now many other women are describing?
sentences.zh: 你能为我们描述一下阿什莉·贾德所描述的，以及现在许多其他女性正在描述的那套系统吗？

sentences.en: Give us a textbook version of how this goes.
sentences.zh: 给我们讲讲这套流程的典型案例。

sentences.en: Here's the thing about listening to actresses tell their Harvey Weinstein harassment stories.
sentences.zh: 听女演员讲述她们被哈维·韦恩斯坦骚扰的故事，情况是这样的。

sentences.en: It's like watching the same movie again and again and again.
sentences.zh: 就像是在一遍又一遍地看同一部电影。

sentences.en: It appears to have been a system.
sentences.zh: 这似乎是一套系统。

sentences.en: It was facilitated by so many people, executives, very low-level assistants who had to do some of the dirty work.
sentences.zh: 它得到了许多人的协助，包括高管，还有那些不得不做一些脏活的底层助理。

sentences.en: There were a lot of logistics involved.
sentences.zh: 其中涉及很多后勤安排。

sentences.en: In every case that we documented, according to the women, Weinstein asked to meet with them for a work reason.
sentences.zh: 在我们记录的每一个案例中，据这些女性所说，韦恩斯坦都是以工作为由要求与她们会面。

sentences.en: And in some of the stories we've heard, what the women describe is a very explicit work for sex, quid pro quo.
sentences.zh: 在我们听到的一些故事中，女性描述的是一种非常明确的“以性换工作”的交换条件。

sentences.en: Other women say that just as Weinstein put the moves on, he essentially name-dropped.
sentences.zh: 其他女性则表示，就在韦恩斯坦采取行动时，他本质上是在搬出大人物的名字。

sentences.en: He said, look at what I've done for this one or that one or implied.
sentences.zh: 他说，看看我为某某人做了什么，或者暗示她们。

sentences.en: If you want to succeed in this business, this is what you have to do.
sentences.zh: 如果你想在这个行业成功，这就是你必须做的。

sentences.en: So if you get intimate with me, I'll be able to make you a big star like such-and-such.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你和我亲密接触，我就能让你成为像某某某那样的大明星。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: Jodi, some of the biggest names in Hollywood have come forward through your reporting.
sentences.zh: 乔迪，一些好莱坞最大牌的明星通过你的报道站了出来。

sentences.en: But what's interesting is that they're describing a pattern that you've just outlined that happened to them when they weren't the biggest names in Hollywood.
sentences.zh: 但有趣的是，她们描述的模式正是你刚才概述的，发生在她们还不是好莱坞最大牌明星的时候。

sentences.en: Who are some of those people and where were they in their careers?
sentences.zh: 她们中有些人是谁？她们当时处于职业生涯的什么阶段？

sentences.en: And the Oscar goes to Gwyneth Paltrow.
sentences.zh: 奥斯卡奖得主是——格温妮丝·帕特洛。

sentences.en: Shakespeare in Love.
sentences.zh: 《莎翁情史》。

sentences.en: Okay, so probably like you and like a lot of people, you know, I had watched Gwyneth Paltrow's career.
sentences.zh: 好吧，可能和你以及很多人一样，你知道，我一直关注着格温妮丝·帕特洛的职业生涯。

sentences.en: Gwyneth Paltrow has appeared in nearly 20 films, including Emma and Sliding Doors.
sentences.zh: 格温妮丝·帕特洛出演了近20部电影，包括《艾玛》和《滑动门》。

sentences.en: This is her first Academy Award.
sentences.zh: 这是她第一次获得奥斯卡奖。

sentences.en: I remember her winning Best Actress for Shakespeare in Love.
sentences.zh: 我记得她凭借《莎翁情史》获得了最佳女主角奖。

sentences.en: And it always seemed like she was so close to Harvey Weinstein.
sentences.zh: 而且她看起来总是和哈维·韦恩斯坦走得很近。

sentences.en: And in fact, she had this kind of nickname called the First Lady of Miramax.
sentences.zh: 事实上，她还有一个绰号，叫“米拉麦克斯的第一夫人”。

sentences.en: I would like to thank Harvey Weinstein and everybody at Miramax Films for their undying support of me.
sentences.zh: 我要感谢哈维·韦恩斯坦和米拉麦克斯影业的所有人，感谢他们对我始终如一的支持。

sentences.en: So I guess I found it particularly shocking when Gwyneth started to tell me the story about Weinstein's unwanted advances on her.
sentences.zh: 所以我猜，当格温妮丝开始向我讲述韦恩斯坦对她进行不轨企图的故事时，我感到特别震惊。

sentences.en: However, the way it goes is basically this.
sentences.zh: 然而，事情的经过基本上是这样的。

sentences.en: She was signed up to do Emma, the Jane Austen adaptation, and one other movie.
sentences.zh: 她当时签约出演简·奥斯汀改编的电影《艾玛》以及另一部电影。

sentences.en: She was very young.
sentences.zh: 她当时非常年轻。

sentences.en: It's kind of an epic period piece.
sentences.zh: 那是一部史诗般的古装剧。

sentences.en: And it was pretty clear that, you know, these were parts that could take her from being an actress to being a star.
sentences.zh: 很明显，你知道，这些角色可以让她从一名演员变成一名明星。

sentences.en: And in fact, they did.
sentences.zh: 事实上，确实如此。

sentences.en: That's what they did for her in the end.
sentences.zh: 最终，这些角色确实成就了她。

sentences.en: But what very few people knew was that when she was signed up but before the movies were shot, she says he invited her to the Peninsula Hotel in L.A.,
sentences.zh: 但很少有人知道的是，当她签约后但在电影拍摄前，她说他邀请她去洛杉矶的半岛酒店，

sentences.en: which is like a real motif in our stories.
sentences.zh: 这在我们故事中是一个真正的主题。

sentences.en: A lot of the harassment allegation stories take place there.
sentences.zh: 许多骚扰指控的故事都发生在那里。

sentences.en: And he invited her in for a meeting that seemed normal at firSt.
sentences.zh: 他邀请她去开会，起初看起来很正常。

sentences.en: It especially seemed normal because the meeting had been set up through her agent.
sentences.zh: 看起来特别正常，因为会议是通过她的经纪人安排的。

sentences.en: So she really had no reason to think that there was going to be anything unusual about walking into this hotel suite.
sentences.zh: 所以她真的没有理由认为走进这个酒店套房会有什么异常。

sentences.en: She had experienced him as, you know, a kind of like benevolent mentor figure.
sentences.zh: 她之前把他视为一个仁慈的导师形象。

sentences.en: She said, you know, sort of like Uncle Harvey.
sentences.zh: 她说，你知道，有点像“哈维叔叔”。

sentences.en: So at the end of the meeting, he actually placed his hands on her and he invited her into the bedroom for massages.
sentences.zh: 所以在会议结束时，他实际上把手放在她身上，并邀请她去卧室进行按摩。

sentences.en: And by the way, she was dating Brad Pitt, which the entire world knew.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，她当时正在和布拉德·皮特约会，全世界都知道这一点。

sentences.en: Including presumably Harvey Weinstein.
sentences.zh: 大概包括哈维·韦恩斯坦在内。

sentences.en: Including presumably Harvey Weinstein.
sentences.zh: 大概包括哈维·韦恩斯坦在内。

sentences.en: So she says no immediately.
sentences.zh: 所以她立刻拒绝了。

sentences.en: She leaves.
sentences.zh: 她离开了。

sentences.en: She's really shaken.
sentences.zh: 她真的被吓坏了。

sentences.en: She tells Pitt immediately.
sentences.zh: 她立刻告诉了皮特。

sentences.en: And shortly thereafter, Gwyneth and Brad run into Harvey at a theater premiere.
sentences.zh: 不久之后，格温妮丝和布拉德在一次电影首映式上遇到了哈维。

sentences.en: And Pitt really confronted Harvey.
sentences.zh: 皮特真的与哈维对质了。

sentences.en: He explicitly told him, if you ever touch my girlfriend again, there is going to be a really big problem.
sentences.zh: 他明确告诉他：如果你再敢碰我女朋友，就会有大麻烦。

sentences.en: Do we know what Weinstein said in response?
sentences.zh: 我们知道韦恩斯坦当时是怎么回应的吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 知道。

sentences.en: So what Gwyneth says is that Harvey's response was to threaten her.
sentences.zh: 格温妮丝说，哈维的回应是威胁她。

sentences.en: That he called her.
sentences.zh: 他给她打了电话。

sentences.en: She was living in downtown New York.
sentences.zh: 她当时住在纽约市中心。

sentences.en: She remembers the call very well.
sentences.zh: 她对那个电话记忆犹新。

sentences.en: And he berated her for having told anybody about this.
sentences.zh: 他斥责她把这件事告诉了任何人。

sentences.en: And her response was, I told my boyfriend.
sentences.zh: 而她的回应是：我告诉了我的男朋友。

sentences.en: Like, when this kind of thing happens to you, you tell your boyfriend.
sentences.zh: 就像，当这种事情发生在你身上时，你会告诉你的男朋友。

sentences.en: That's what you do.
sentences.zh: 这就是你会做的。

sentences.en: And then she said he threatened her.
sentences.zh: 然后她说他威胁了她。

sentences.en: And he said, you know, something to the effect of, she didn't remember the exact word, something to the effect of you're going to ruin everything.
sentences.zh: 他说，你知道，大意是——她记不清确切的词了——大意是“你会毁了一切”。

sentences.en: And remember, I just want to pause here and remember.
sentences.zh: 记住，我想在这里停顿一下，记住这一点。

sentences.en: Yeah, the circumstances of her career.
sentences.zh: 是的，她职业生涯的环境。

sentences.en: She had work on the line.
sentences.zh: 她的工作岌岌可危。

sentences.en: And her quote to me was, I was expected to keep the secret.
sentences.zh: 她对我说的话是：“我被要求保守秘密。”

sentences.en: You know, so all of these years go on.
sentences.zh: 你知道，就这样过了这么多年。

sentences.en: And she becomes even more successful.
sentences.zh: 她变得更加成功了。

sentences.en: And she wins this best actress picture.
sentences.zh: 她赢得了这个最佳女主角奖。

sentences.en: In another Weinstein production.
sentences.zh: 在另一部韦恩斯坦制作的电影中。

sentences.en: In another Weinstein production.
sentences.zh: 在另一部韦恩斯坦制作的电影中。

sentences.en: And she felt like in public, you know, she had to do her job.
sentences.zh: 她觉得在公开场合，你知道，她必须做好她的工作。

sentences.en: She kind of plays the glowing star to, you know, his powerful producer.
sentences.zh: 她扮演着光芒四射的明星，而他是强大的制片人。

sentences.en: This is really Harvey Weinstein at the very peak of his powers.
sentences.zh: 这真的是哈维·韦恩斯坦权势最巅峰的时期。

sentences.en: I want to talk about how clear it's becoming that to people inside the entertainment industry, Weinstein's behavior, Jodi, was an open secret.
sentences.zh: 我想谈谈这一点变得多么清晰：对于娱乐行业内部的人来说，韦恩斯坦的行为，乔迪，是一个公开的秘密。

sentences.en: It sounds like another theme in these stories was that women had already heard about it from other women or continued to hear about it in Hollywood.
sentences.zh: 听起来这些故事中的另一个主题是，女性已经从其他女性那里听说过这件事，或者在好莱坞不断听到关于他的传闻。

sentences.en: So the question is really, who knew about it beforehand and did they do anything?
sentences.zh: 所以真正的问题是，谁事先知道这件事，他们做了什么吗？

sentences.en: And without pointing any specific fingers, I want to read you something.
sentences.zh: 在不指名道姓的情况下，我想读给你听一些东西。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So there's nothing more central to the film industry than the Oscars, right?
sentences.zh: 电影行业没有比奥斯卡更核心的了，对吧？

sentences.en: Good morning.
sentences.zh: 早上好。

sentences.en: I'm Seth MacFarlane, the host of the Oscars.
sentences.zh: 我是塞思·麦克法兰，奥斯卡颁奖典礼的主持人。

sentences.en: This is a joke that was made at the Oscar announcements.
sentences.zh: 这是一个在奥斯卡提名公布时开的玩笑。

sentences.en: A very, very public event.
sentences.zh: 一个非常、非常公开的活动。

sentences.en: The 2012 nominees for Best Performance by an Actress in a Supporting Role are...
sentences.zh: 2012年最佳女配角提名者是……

sentences.en: He's announcing a bunch of female acting nominees and he says...
sentences.zh: 他正在宣布一堆女性表演提名者，他说……

sentences.en: Congratulations, you five ladies no longer have to pretend to be attracted to Harvey Weinstein.
sentences.zh: 恭喜你们五位女士，你们再也不用假装被哈维·韦恩斯坦吸引了。

sentences.en: For Best Animated Feature Film, the nominees are...
sentences.zh: 最佳动画长片提名者是……

sentences.en: If anybody now or in coming days in Hollywood tells you that they did not know or suspect that there was a problem here,
sentences.zh: 如果现在或未来几天好莱坞有人告诉你，他们不知道或怀疑这里有问题，

sentences.en: look back at that joke and say, then why was the guy who was hosting the Oscar nominations joking openly about it?
sentences.zh: 回顾一下那个玩笑，然后问：那为什么主持奥斯卡提名仪式的人会公开拿这件事开玩笑？

sentences.en: We all seem to be going back in pop culture now and finding moments where a joke was made in a show like 30 Rock.
sentences.zh: 我们现在似乎都在回顾流行文化，寻找像《我为喜剧狂》这样的节目中开玩笑的时刻。

sentences.en: Oh, please.
sentences.zh: 哦，拜托。

sentences.en: I'm not afraid of anyone in show business.
sentences.zh: 我不怕演艺圈里的任何人。

sentences.en: I turned down intercourse with Harvey Weinstein on no less than three occasions out of five.
sentences.zh: 我拒绝了哈维·韦恩斯坦不少于三次性交要求。

sentences.en: And when you start to piece these cultural moments together, it's startling how frequently someone seemed to make a public pronouncement,
sentences.zh: 当你开始把这些文化时刻拼凑在一起时，你会惊讶地发现，竟然有人如此频繁地做出公开声明，

sentences.en: slyly, indirectly, but make a pronouncement, that they suspected that Harvey Weinstein was doing bad things to women.
sentences.zh: 虽然是狡黠的、间接的，但确实做出了声明，表明他们怀疑哈维·韦恩斯坦在对女性做坏事。

sentences.en: I have to tell you, this is why we wanted to report this story, Michael.
sentences.zh: 我必须告诉你，迈克尔，这就是我们想要报道这个故事的原因。

sentences.en: I mean, how could something be so strangely public and yet never be documented, never be proven?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，怎么会有事情如此奇怪地公开，却从未被记录，从未被证实？

sentences.en: Are you surprised that so many more women and so many more stories have come forward since you started?
sentences.zh: 自从你开始报道以来，有这么多女性站出来，有这么多故事被披露，你感到惊讶吗？

sentences.en: When you started this reporting, did you expect this cascade of stories to be coming out?
sentences.zh: 当你开始这篇报道时，你预料到会有这一连串的故事涌现吗？

sentences.en: Well, so I'm asking the same question that I did at the start of the reporting, but in a completely different way, which is, what is the size and scope of this thing?
sentences.zh: 嗯，我问的问题和报道开始时一样，但方式完全不同，那就是：这件事的规模和范围有多大？

sentences.en: How many people were affected?
sentences.zh: 有多少人受到了影响？

sentences.en: You know, all of us sat there and watched these films and watched the Oscars.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们所有人都坐在那里看这些电影，看奥斯卡颁奖礼。

sentences.en: But what was really going on behind the scenes?
sentences.zh: 但幕后到底发生了什么？

sentences.en: And you're also, I suppose, asking how many people knew.
sentences.zh: 我想你也在问有多少人知道。

sentences.en: How many people knew?
sentences.zh: 有多少人知道？

sentences.en: The Times is reporting that last Thursday, after the investigation was first published,
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》报道称，上周四，在调查首次发表后，

sentences.en: Harvey Weinstein sent an email to top agents and studio executives saying he was desperate for help and imploring them to ask the board of the Weinstein Company not to fire him.
sentences.zh: 哈维·韦恩斯坦给顶级经纪人和制片厂高管发了一封电子邮件，说他迫切需要帮助，并恳求他们要求韦恩斯坦公司的董事会不要解雇他。

sentences.en: On Tuesday, one of the recipients of the email, Jeffrey Katzenberg, the former chairman of Disney
sentences.zh: 周二，这封邮件的收件人之一，前迪士尼主席兼梦工厂首席执行官杰弗里·卡森伯格，

sentences.en: and CEO of DreamWorks, made public the response he'd sent Weinstein, his longtime friend.
sentences.zh: 公开了他发给老朋友韦恩斯坦的回信。

sentences.en: Hey, Harvey, it started.
sentences.zh: 嘿，哈维，事情已经开始了。

sentences.en: You stated in your email that, quote, a lot of the allegations are false, as you know.
sentences.zh: 你在邮件中声称，引用你的话，“正如你所知，很多指控都是虚假的。”

sentences.en: Well, actually, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 嗯，其实，我也不知道。

sentences.en: It seems to me we are now down to degrees of horrible.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，我们现在是在比谁更糟糕。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁了？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道，你需要订阅《纽约时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果能让你免费试用一个月《纽约时报》，而且无需绑定信用卡呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能读到什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用程序，获取30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I was 23, 23 years old.
sentences.zh: 那时我23岁，23岁。

sentences.en: I had just gotten out of acting school and I'd gotten a great agent, I thought, and was happy going on auditions and taking meetings.
sentences.zh: 我刚从表演学校毕业，我觉得自己签了一位很棒的经纪人，很高兴能去参加试镜和开会。

sentences.en: And I met with lots of different studios to have generals and casting directors.
sentences.zh: 我见了很多不同的制片厂和选角导演，进行常规会面。

sentences.en: And, you know, it was pretty much my first year of auditioning in New York City.
sentences.zh: 你知道，那基本上是我在纽约市参加试镜的第一年。

sentences.en: Catherine Kendall is one of the women to come forward this past week.
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳·肯德尔是过去一周站出来的女性之一。

sentences.en: And I met with Miramax and I met Harvey and it was at the Miramax office.
sentences.zh: 我见了米拉麦克斯影业，也见了哈维，就在米拉麦克斯的办公室里。

sentences.en: He gave me a couple scripts to look at.
sentences.zh: 他给了我几个剧本让我看看。

sentences.en: One of them was, I remember, Beautiful Girls.
sentences.zh: 我记得其中一个是《美丽女孩》。

sentences.en: And he was really kind to me in the office and was in front of everyone.
sentences.zh: 他在办公室里对我很客气，而且是在所有人面前。

sentences.en: Sort of said, said, welcome to the Miramax family.
sentences.zh: 算是说了句，欢迎加入米拉麦克斯大家庭。

sentences.en: I thought, all right, great, you know.
sentences.zh: 我想，好吧，太棒了，你知道的。

sentences.en: So it was a big deal to be connected with Miramax at all, it sounds like.
sentences.zh: 听起来能和米拉麦克斯扯上关系是一件大事。

sentences.en: I thought so, yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 我是这么想的，是的，绝对是。

sentences.en: And what did you know about Harvey Weinstein at the time?
sentences.zh: 当时你对哈维·温斯坦了解多少？

sentences.en: I knew that he had produced a movie, Cinema Paradiso.
sentences.zh: 我知道他制作了一部电影，《天堂电影院》。

sentences.en: It was one of my favorite movies.
sentences.zh: 那是我最喜欢的电影之一。

sentences.en: It's one of my favorite movies, too.
sentences.zh: 那也是我最喜欢的电影之一。

sentences.en: Is it?
sentences.zh: 是吗？

sentences.en: I loved it.
sentences.zh: 我非常喜欢它。

sentences.en: And I think that was one of the reasons that I felt like trusting with him.
sentences.zh: 我想这也是我当时觉得可以信任他的原因之一。

sentences.en: Like, how could someone who loves art.
sentences.zh: 就像，一个热爱艺术的人怎么会……

sentences.en: It's such a tender story.
sentences.zh: 那是一个非常温柔的故事。

sentences.en: It's so tender, exactly.
sentences.zh: 确实非常温柔，没错。

sentences.en: You know, he must get it, you know.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他肯定懂这些，你知道的。

sentences.en: And I think he has that side to him.
sentences.zh: 而且我觉得他确实有那一面。

sentences.en: That side that can really manipulate so well and make you think that he is a tender person himself.
sentences.zh: 那一面能让他非常擅长操纵人心，让你觉得他本人也是个温柔的人。

sentences.en: But, I mean, there's something about being in his presence.
sentences.zh: 但是，我是说，待在他身边总有一种感觉。

sentences.en: You just know that he has a lot of power.
sentences.zh: 你就是知道他拥有很大的权力。

sentences.en: So take us to that first meeting, one-on-one with him.
sentences.zh: 那么带我们回到那次第一次一对一的会面吧。

sentences.en: You know, it's funny.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这很有趣。

sentences.en: Looking back, there's a lot of negotiating with him.
sentences.zh: 回想起来，当时有很多与他的博弈。

sentences.en: There's a lot of, like, me trying to get out of it.
sentences.zh: 有很多像是我试图摆脱他的过程。

sentences.en: Him saying, well, just come over.
sentences.zh: 他说，好吧，过来一下。

sentences.en: Come for a drink.
sentences.zh: 来喝杯酒。

sentences.en: Well, no, that's okay.
sentences.zh: 嗯，不，没关系。

sentences.en: I don't really drink.
sentences.zh: 我不怎么喝酒。

sentences.en: Well, okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧，没关系。

sentences.en: Let's just walk up this block here.
sentences.zh: 我们就在这条街上走走吧。

sentences.en: I have to run upstairs real quick.
sentences.zh: 我得赶紧上楼一趟。

sentences.en: Just walk with me up here.
sentences.zh: 陪我走上去吧。

sentences.en: Okay, well, I'll wait down here.
sentences.zh: 好吧，那我在楼下等你。

sentences.en: No, no, and he finds a way to go back and forth with you enough so that you finally just go, okay, all right, all right, okay, okay, I'll go upstairs, you know.
sentences.zh: 不，不，他总能找到办法跟你来回拉扯，直到你最后说，好吧，行，行，好吧，好吧，我上楼就是了，你知道的。

sentences.en: So we walk upstairs.
sentences.zh: 于是我们走上楼。

sentences.en: I remember I saw pictures of his wife on the wall and said, oh, your wife's really pretty.
sentences.zh: 我记得我看到墙上挂着他妻子的照片，就说，哦，你妻子真漂亮。

sentences.en: I ended up sitting down in a sofa across the room from him.
sentences.zh: 最后我坐在房间对面的一张沙发上。

sentences.en: He made himself a drink.
sentences.zh: 他给自己倒了杯酒。

sentences.en: I didn't have one.
sentences.zh: 我没喝。

sentences.en: And we proceeded to talk about art, movies, books he loved.
sentences.zh: 我们接着聊了艺术、电影和他喜欢的书。

sentences.en: And then he legitimizes it again by sitting across the room from you.
sentences.zh: 然后他又通过坐在房间对面来让这一切显得合情合理。

sentences.en: And you felt he was taking you seriously at this point as an actress.
sentences.zh: 那时候你觉得他作为一名演员是在认真对待你吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: It's funny because as you're asking me the questions, I realized that there is this sort of back and forth of, like, safe, unsafe, safe, unsafe.
sentences.zh: 很有趣，因为当你问我这些问题时，我意识到这中间有一种来回的拉锯，像是安全、不安全、安全、不安全。

sentences.en: And I think he plays into the safe part until he can get to the unsafe part.
sentences.zh: 我觉得他一直在利用安全的那部分，直到他能进入不安全的部分。

sentences.en: But looking back, I see how manipulative it was.
sentences.zh: 但回想起来，我才看出这有多么操纵人心。

sentences.en: What do you mean by the safe, unsafe part?
sentences.zh: 你说的安全、不安全部分是什么意思？

sentences.en: There was a way he made it safe.
sentences.zh: 他有一种方式让一切看起来很安全。

sentences.en: There was a way he saw me being fearful and convinced me, but did it in a way that played into the things I needed to know to make it safe for me.
sentences.zh: 他看出了我的恐惧，并说服了我，但他所用的方式正好利用了我需要知道的信息，让我觉得这很安全。

sentences.en: Right?
sentences.zh: 对吧？

sentences.en: Like, my wife could be home.
sentences.zh: 比如，我妻子可能在家。

sentences.en: Or, oh, I'll show you pictures of my kids.
sentences.zh: 或者，哦，我给你看我孩子的照片。

sentences.en: I mean, there's sort of things that he knew he was throwing out there to let me know, don't worry, it's safe.
sentences.zh: 我是说，他抛出这些东西就是为了让我知道，别担心，这很安全。

sentences.en: I think he could sense my uneasiness for sure.
sentences.zh: 我想他肯定能感觉到我的不安。

sentences.en: And so that he would then take a step towards making me feel at ease again.
sentences.zh: 所以他会进一步采取行动，让我再次感到安心。

sentences.en: And then he has this intellectual conversation with you where you feel like you're being taken seriously and that feels so good.
sentences.zh: 然后他会和你进行那种知性的对话，让你觉得你被认真对待了，那种感觉真好。

sentences.en: And then he got up and he went to the bathroom.
sentences.zh: 然后他站起来去了趟洗手间。

sentences.en: And it was around time that I felt like I was going to be leaving.
sentences.zh: 那时我感觉我该离开了。

sentences.en: And he came back out and he was wearing a robe.
sentences.zh: 他出来时穿着一件长袍。

sentences.en: And I thought, this is so weird.
sentences.zh: 我想，这太奇怪了。

sentences.en: And he said, will you give me a massage?
sentences.zh: 他说，你能给我按摩一下吗？

sentences.en: And I said, no, no, I'm not comfortable doing that.
sentences.zh: 我说，不，不，我不习惯那样做。

sentences.en: And he said, oh, come on, everybody does it.
sentences.zh: 他说，哦，拜托，大家都这么做。

sentences.en: And then he name dropped a couple of people, one famous model in particular.
sentences.zh: 然后他随口提了几个人的名字，特别是一位著名的模特。

sentences.en: And he suggested that they all had given him the massage.
sentences.zh: 他暗示她们都给他按摩过。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And that they do it all the time.
sentences.zh: 而且她们经常这么做。

sentences.en: What's the big deal?
sentences.zh: 这有什么大不了的？

sentences.en: And what were you thinking about?
sentences.zh: 那你当时在想什么？

sentences.en: Sorry, go ahead, sorry.
sentences.zh: 抱歉，你继续，抱歉。

sentences.en: Keep going, I bought it.
sentences.zh: 继续说，我当时信了。

sentences.en: No, no, it's okay.
sentences.zh: 不，不，没关系。

sentences.en: I just thought to myself, well, it's a big deal to me.
sentences.zh: 我只是心想，嗯，这对我来说就是件大事。

sentences.en: And at this point, I'm feeling like my heart's starting to beat really faSt.
sentences.zh: 就在这时，我感觉我的心跳开始变得非常快。

sentences.en: I also felt pretty steadfast, like there's no way I'm going to do it.
sentences.zh: 我也感到非常坚定，心想我绝对不会那样做。

sentences.en: I'm not comfortable and I'm not going to do it.
sentences.zh: 我不舒服，我不会那样做的。

sentences.en: And then he kind of went into like a begging, like back, come on, you know, come on, like back and forth, like one more try.
sentences.zh: 然后他开始哀求，像是来回拉扯，拜托，你知道的，拜托，就像来回推搡，再试一次。

sentences.en: And I sort of got my things up to get ready to leave.
sentences.zh: 我收拾好东西准备离开。

sentences.en: And he left the room and this time he came back completely head to toe, naked.
sentences.zh: 他离开了房间，这次回来时全身一丝不挂。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Just naked.
sentences.zh: 就是赤身裸体。

sentences.en: And he's a big guy.
sentences.zh: 而且他是个大块头。

sentences.en: And he's between me and the apartment door.
sentences.zh: 他就挡在我与公寓门之间。

sentences.en: He said, well, if you won't give me a massage, will you at least show me your breasts?
sentences.zh: 他说，好吧，如果你不给我按摩，至少让我看看你的胸部吧？

sentences.en: Will you lift up your shirt and show me your breasts?
sentences.zh: 你能掀起衬衫让我看看你的胸部吗？

sentences.en: This is unbelievable.
sentences.zh: 这简直不可思议。

sentences.en: And then he sort of had his hands out and was doing that back and forth dance from side to side to not let me pass.
sentences.zh: 然后他伸出双手，左右来回晃动，不让我通过。

sentences.en: Like a shuffle.
sentences.zh: 就像在跳舞一样。

sentences.en: Do you know what I'm talking about?
sentences.zh: 你知道我在说什么吗？

sentences.en: How someone sort of, you know, I'm blocking the door and I won't let you pass.
sentences.zh: 就像有人挡着门，不让你通过。

sentences.en: Like it was maybe a game to him or something.
sentences.zh: 就好像这对他来说是个游戏之类的。

sentences.en: And so now I'm trapped.
sentences.zh: 现在我被困住了。

sentences.en: But, you know, that's when it really got like surreal, out of body, sort of, but, you know, this, is this really happening?
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，那时候感觉真的很超现实，灵魂出窍，你知道，这，这真的在发生吗？

sentences.en: Is this going to happen to me right now?
sentences.zh: 这真的要发生在我身上了吗？

sentences.en: Is this the moment that it happens where like I'm just going to leave my body, I guess, and this is going to happen?
sentences.zh: 这是那一刻吗，我猜我可能会灵魂出窍，然后这事就要发生了？

sentences.en: But at the same time, I thought I had that feeling of strength, too.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，我觉得自己也有一种力量感。

sentences.en: Like I felt like there's no way you're going to get me, you know, I will get past you.
sentences.zh: 我觉得你不可能得逞，你知道，我会从你身边过去的。

sentences.en: And there was even a moment where I felt like you're just a pathetic, small little boy, honestly.
sentences.zh: 甚至有一瞬间，我真的觉得你只是个可怜、渺小的小男孩。

sentences.en: I mean, there was sort of flip-flop between like he could rape me.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我当时在两种想法之间摇摆，比如他可能会强奸我。

sentences.en: He's huge.
sentences.zh: 他太庞大了。

sentences.en: He could definitely pin me down and I will not get past him.
sentences.zh: 他绝对能把我按住，我没法从他身边过去。

sentences.en: And there was another part of me that was like, I will get past him.
sentences.zh: 但我内心还有另一个声音说，我会从他身边过去的。

sentences.en: I will get past him.
sentences.zh: 我会从他身边过去的。

sentences.en: And then I told him how mad I was and how upset I was.
sentences.zh: 然后我告诉他我有多生气，多难过。

sentences.en: And I just flat out said, I'm so disappointed that you would do this to me.
sentences.zh: 我直接说，你对我做这种事，我太失望了。

sentences.en: How did you get out of the apartment?
sentences.zh: 你是怎么离开那间公寓的？

sentences.en: Again, there was like a weird negotiation.
sentences.zh: 又是一场奇怪的博弈。

sentences.en: He said, I'll let you go.
sentences.zh: 他说，我会让你走的。

sentences.en: Like he literally, I think he even said, I will let you go if you just give me a minute and let me take you to the taxi.
sentences.zh: 他甚至说，只要你给我一分钟，让我送你上出租车，我就让你走。

sentences.en: And I guess I went for that negotiation.
sentences.zh: 我想我接受了这个条件。

sentences.en: I don't know why, looking back, that I didn't just bolt out of the room.
sentences.zh: 回想起来，我不知道为什么我当时没有直接冲出房间。

sentences.en: I let him get dressed and take me downstairs.
sentences.zh: 我让他穿好衣服，带我下楼。

sentences.en: But I know that my body was shaking and trembling.
sentences.zh: 但我知道我的身体在颤抖。

sentences.en: And I know that my legs were shaking underneath me as I stepped down the stairs.
sentences.zh: 我知道当我走下楼梯时，我的双腿在发抖。

sentences.en: That I felt like I could fall down the stairs because my knees might give out.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我可能会摔下楼梯，因为我的膝盖可能支撑不住了。

sentences.en: And I got in the cab with him.
sentences.zh: 我跟他一起上了出租车。

sentences.en: And I thought he was going to just put me in a cab to go home.
sentences.zh: 我以为他只是会送我上车回家。

sentences.en: But he got in the cab too.
sentences.zh: 但他自己也上了车。

sentences.en: Which was so weird and strange.
sentences.zh: 这太奇怪、太诡异了。

sentences.en: And then I got out at a bar on the lower west side.
sentences.zh: 后来我在下西区的一家酒吧下了车。

sentences.en: And I went straight into the bar.
sentences.zh: 我径直走进酒吧。

sentences.en: And I asked the bartender to talk to me like he knew me.
sentences.zh: 我让酒保跟我说话，装作认识我的样子。

sentences.en: I said, just please start talking to me like you know me.
sentences.zh: 我说，求你了，装作认识我跟我说话吧。

sentences.en: Please just talk to me.
sentences.zh: 求你跟我说说话。

sentences.en: Just please talk to me.
sentences.zh: 求你跟我说说话。

sentences.en: And I could see Harvey sitting in the taxi looking at me through the window of the cab.
sentences.zh: 我能看到哈维坐在出租车里，透过车窗看着我。

sentences.en: For like a good 20 minutes.
sentences.zh: 足足看了有20分钟。

sentences.en: I don't know why.
sentences.zh: 我不知道为什么。

sentences.en: I don't know why he stared at me through the window of the cab.
sentences.zh: 我不知道他为什么透过车窗盯着我。

sentences.en: Watching me in the bar like what was I going to do in there?
sentences.zh: 在酒吧里看着我，想看我会在里面做什么？

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: But it was so creepy.
sentences.zh: 但这太令人毛骨悚然了。

sentences.en: So he's still basically with you in a sense.
sentences.zh: 所以从某种意义上说，他基本上还和你在一起。

sentences.en: He's monitoring you, chasing you.
sentences.zh: 他在监视你，追逐你。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And he called me the next day.
sentences.zh: 第二天他又给我打了电话。

sentences.en: And he called me actually like several times in the following weeks.
sentences.zh: 事实上，在接下来的几周里，他又给我打了几次电话。

sentences.en: And I mean to me it was because he knew.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，对我来说，这是因为他心里有数。

sentences.en: And he wanted to make sure that I was like either not going to say anything.
sentences.zh: 他想确保我不会说出任何事情。

sentences.en: Or I don't know.
sentences.zh: 或者我不知道。

sentences.en: But you know he was covering.
sentences.zh: 但你知道，他在掩盖事实。

sentences.en: And I was pretty shut down at that point.
sentences.zh: 那时我已经完全封闭了自己。

sentences.en: Because I really felt scared.
sentences.zh: 因为我真的感到害怕。

sentences.en: Like he was in this all powerful position.
sentences.zh: 就好像他处于一个全能的地位。

sentences.en: And I was clearly never going to work again if I said anything.
sentences.zh: 而且很明显，如果我说了什么，我就再也无法工作了。

sentences.en: And the other part to it is he didn't actually touch me.
sentences.zh: 另一部分原因是，他实际上并没有碰我。

sentences.en: So you know I wasn't I wasn't sure if people would care if I'm not bleeding and you know just wrecked.
sentences.zh: 所以你知道，我不确定如果我没有流血，没有被摧毁，人们是否会在意。

sentences.en: Then does it really matter?
sentences.zh: 那这真的重要吗？

sentences.en: It sounds like you were having a debate with yourself over whether there was anything to be done about it.
sentences.zh: 听起来你当时在和自己争论，是否应该对此采取行动。

sentences.en: And if there was anyone to tell about it.
sentences.zh: 以及是否有任何人可以倾诉。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是。

sentences.en: And what was the decision that you made?
sentences.zh: 那你最后做出的决定是什么？

sentences.en: That there wasn't.
sentences.zh: 决定什么都不做。

sentences.en: I was just scared of him.
sentences.zh: 我只是怕他。

sentences.en: I just was.
sentences.zh: 我就是怕。

sentences.en: I think that all these people must have been just as terrified this whole time.
sentences.zh: 我想所有这些人一直以来肯定都同样恐惧。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I think that when people perpetrate against you.
sentences.zh: 我认为当人们对你施加侵害时。

sentences.en: I'm almost going to cry saying it.
sentences.zh: 说到这里我快要哭了。

sentences.en: But like I think that when people perpetrate against you.
sentences.zh: 但我觉得，当人们对你施加侵害时。

sentences.en: You are the one that feels the shame.
sentences.zh: 感到羞耻的是你自己。

sentences.en: And so you kind of walk around like this with this private shame feeling.
sentences.zh: 所以你就像这样带着这种私密的羞耻感四处走动。

sentences.en: Catherine what is the shame like that you're describing here?
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳，你所描述的这种羞耻感是什么样的？

sentences.en: How does it manifest in you?
sentences.zh: 它在你身上是如何体现的？

sentences.en: I think it's a feeling of like a little bit of a feeling of like dirtiness.
sentences.zh: 我觉得那是一种有点脏兮兮的感觉。

sentences.en: Like something's been put on you.
sentences.zh: 就像有什么东西被强加在你身上。

sentences.en: Some kind of it's almost like you've been slimed.
sentences.zh: 某种……几乎就像你被粘液糊了一身。

sentences.en: And you think that it's just you.
sentences.zh: 而且你以为只有你一个人这样。

sentences.en: And I bet you all those other women thought it too.
sentences.zh: 我敢打赌其他所有女性也这么想。

sentences.en: Did you recognize their stories when they started to tell them the details the scenarios?
sentences.zh: 当她们开始讲述细节和场景时，你认出她们的故事了吗？
百分之百。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I imagine you had so many different feelings around this living and working in Hollywood.
sentences.zh: 我想你在好莱坞生活和工作时，对此一定有各种各样的感受。

sentences.en: Where Weinstein is so present both physically and in all the films he's involved in.
sentences.zh: 韦恩斯坦不仅在身体上，而且在他参与的所有电影中都无处不在。

sentences.en: Tell me about what it felt like to be so aware of how ingrained he was in the culture of the industry.
sentences.zh: 告诉我，当你意识到他在这个行业文化中根深蒂固时，是什么感觉？

sentences.en: I saw him years later at a premiere and I started to shake and I thought I got to get out of here.
sentences.zh: 多年后我在首映式上见到他，我开始发抖，心想我得离开这里。

sentences.en: I got to run.
sentences.zh: 我得跑。

sentences.en: And one of my girlfriends saw me and she's like, what is going on?
sentences.zh: 我的一位女性朋友看到我，问我怎么了？

sentences.en: And I was like, I have to get out of here.
sentences.zh: 我说，我必须离开这里。

sentences.en: I have to leave.
sentences.zh: 我必须走。

sentences.en: And she was like, what the hell happened to you?
sentences.zh: 她问我到底发生了什么事？

sentences.en: What's happening?
sentences.zh: 怎么了？

sentences.en: And she was sort of horrified and then I kind of knew like this is not over for me.
sentences.zh: 她当时很震惊，然后我意识到，这件事对我来说还没结束。

sentences.en: Like I'm not, I thought that this was over.
sentences.zh: 我以为这已经结束了。

sentences.en: It's not.
sentences.zh: 并没有。

sentences.en: Like his name has an enormous charge still when it's mentioned.
sentences.zh: 他的名字被提起时，依然带着巨大的冲击力。

sentences.en: Like my body and my whole sort of mind sees up.
sentences.zh: 就像我的身体和整个心灵都僵住了。

sentences.en: It's like all these years later, he's still sort of right outside the window just watching.
sentences.zh: 就像这么多年过去了，他依然站在窗外注视着。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Catherine, do you think in some ways that seeing that you weren't actually alone in this, in this feeling you have, this anxiety and this power that Harvey has,
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳，你是否认为在某种程度上，看到你并不是唯一一个有这种感觉、这种焦虑以及哈维所拥有的这种权力的人，

sentences.en: that that might change your relationship with the memory of what happened all these years later?
sentences.zh: 这可能会改变你多年后对所发生之事的记忆吗？

sentences.en: I do.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I do.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I think it will.
sentences.zh: 我想会的。

sentences.en: I think it will change my memory.
sentences.zh: 我想这会改变我的记忆。

sentences.en: I think that, you know, I already feel like I'm silently holding hands with the other women that have been through this.
sentences.zh: 我觉得，你知道，我已经感觉到自己在默默地与那些经历过同样事情的女性携手。

sentences.en: And, and there's a great power in that.
sentences.zh: 那其中蕴含着巨大的力量。

sentences.en: Catherine, I really want to thank you.
sentences.zh: 凯瑟琳，我真的非常感谢你。

sentences.en: You're so welcome.
sentences.zh: 不客气。

sentences.en: On Tuesday morning, The New Yorker released as part of its reporting on Weinstein, audio from a New York Police Department sting operation in 2015,
sentences.zh: 周二上午，《纽约客》作为其关于韦恩斯坦报道的一部分，发布了2015年纽约警察局一次卧底行动的录音，

sentences.en: involving the model Ombra Badawana Gutierrez.
sentences.zh: 涉及模特安布拉·巴达瓦纳·古铁雷斯。
zh_words: 模特安布拉·巴达瓦纳·古铁雷斯

sentences.en: No, yesterday was kind of aggressive for me.
sentences.zh: 不，昨天对我来说有点咄咄逼人。

sentences.en: I need to know a person to be touched.
sentences.zh: 我需要了解一个人才能被触碰。

sentences.en: I won't do a thing, please.
sentences.zh: 我什么都不会做的，求你了。

sentences.en: I swear I won't.
sentences.zh: 我发誓我不会。

sentences.en: Just sit with me.
sentences.zh: 就坐在这陪陪我。

sentences.en: Don't embarrass me in the hotel.
sentences.zh: 别让我在酒店里难堪。

sentences.en: I'm here all the time.
sentences.zh: 我一直都在这儿。

sentences.en: I know, but I don't want to.
sentences.zh: 我知道，但我不想。

sentences.en: Please sit there.
sentences.zh: 请坐在那儿。

sentences.en: Please.
sentences.zh: 求你了。

sentences.en: Weinstein asks Gutierrez to come with him up to his hotel room.
sentences.zh: 韦恩斯坦要求古铁雷斯和他一起去他的酒店房间。

sentences.en: If you don't, if you embarrass me in this hotel room.
sentences.zh: 如果你不这样做，如果你让我在这个酒店房间里难堪。

sentences.en: I'm not embarrassing you.
sentences.zh: 我没有让你难堪。

sentences.en: It's just that I don't, I don't feel comfortable.
sentences.zh: 只是我……我感觉不舒服。

sentences.en: I mean, don't have a thing with me in the home room.
sentences.zh: 我是说，别在酒店房间里对我做那种事。

sentences.en: It's not nice.
sentences.zh: 这不好。

sentences.en: Please, I'm not going to do anything.
sentences.zh: 求你了，我什么都不会做的。

sentences.en: I swear my children, please come in on everything.
sentences.zh: 我以我的孩子们发誓，求你进来，我什么都答应。

sentences.en: I'm a famous guy.
sentences.zh: 我是个名人。

sentences.en: I'm feeling very uncomfortable right now.
sentences.zh: 我现在感觉非常不舒服。

sentences.en: Please come in now and one minute.
sentences.zh: 求你进来，就一分钟。

sentences.en: And if you want to leave, when the guy comes with my jacket, you can go.
sentences.zh: 如果你想走，等那个人送我的夹克过来，你就可以走。

sentences.en: Why yesterday you touched my wrist?
sentences.zh: 为什么昨天你碰了我的手腕？

sentences.en: No, please, I'm sorry.
sentences.zh: 不，求你了，对不起。

sentences.en: Just come on.
sentences.zh: 快进来吧。

sentences.en: I'm used to that.
sentences.zh: 我习惯那样了。

sentences.en: In a statement on Tuesday, a spokeswoman for Weinstein told the Times, quote, any allegations of non-consensual sex are unequivocally denied by Mr. Weinstein.
sentences.zh: 周二，韦恩斯坦的一位女发言人在一份声明中告诉《泰晤士报》，引用如下：韦恩斯坦先生明确否认任何关于非自愿性行为的指控。

sentences.en: He will not be available for further comments, as he is taking the time to focus on his family, on getting counseling, and rebuilding his life.
sentences.zh: 他将不会再发表评论，因为他正花时间专注于家庭、接受心理咨询并重建生活。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的事情。

sentences.en: I was awakened by the smell of smoke, but I didn't know what it was.
sentences.zh: 我是被烟味熏醒的，但我不知道那是什么。

sentences.en: We went in our living room, looked out, saw a light flickering in the sky, and the police were knocking on our door, telling us we had to evacuate.
sentences.zh: 我们走进客厅，向外看，看到天空中闪烁着光亮，警察在敲我们的门，告诉我们必须撤离。

sentences.en: It started for us on Monday night at 2 a.m.
sentences.zh: 对我们来说，这一切始于周一凌晨2点。

sentences.en: We had neighbors pounding on our windows, pounding on our doors, saying, you have to leave, we have to evacuate.
sentences.zh: 邻居们在敲我们的窗户，敲我们的门，说，你们必须离开，我们必须撤离。

sentences.en: And when I opened the front door, I saw smoke, I saw ashes.
sentences.zh: 当我打开前门时，我看到了烟雾，看到了灰烬。

sentences.en: So I just screamed at my family to get in the car, get in the car, get in the car.
sentences.zh: 所以我只是对着家人尖叫，快上车，快上车，快上车。

sentences.en: The wildfires raging across Northern California have prompted 20,000 people to flee their homes on foot and by car as the flames overtook their towns.
sentences.zh: 加州北部肆虐的野火导致2万人在火焰吞没城镇时，徒步或驾车逃离家园。

sentences.en: There were so many people evacuating.
sentences.zh: 撤离的人太多了。

sentences.en: I think that was the problem.
sentences.zh: 我想这就是问题所在。

sentences.en: There was just thousands and thousands of people trying to leave.
sentences.zh: 有成千上万的人试图离开。

sentences.en: The fires, centered around Sonoma and Napa counties, have already killed at least 15 people and destroyed more than 2,000 buildings.
sentences.zh: 这些以索诺玛县和纳帕县为中心的火灾已经造成至少15人死亡，并摧毁了2000多座建筑物。

sentences.en: As of Tuesday night, 17 large fires were still burning.
sentences.zh: 截至周二晚间，仍有17场大火在燃烧。

sentences.en: A fire chief described the two biggest blazes as 0% contained.
sentences.zh: 一位消防队长称两场最大的火灾控制率为0%。

sentences.en: We're just grateful that we're both alive and well.
sentences.zh: 我们只是很庆幸我们俩都还活着，而且平安无事。

sentences.en: Very, very grateful to the Santa Rosa Police Department.
sentences.zh: 非常、非常感谢圣罗莎警察局。

sentences.en: Thank you for asking.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你的关心。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.zh: 敬请收听关于如何让客人感到宾至如归的建议。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是需要全黑环境才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是否会睡得不省人事。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们需要什么样的光线？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为那是非常具体的要求。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们喝咖啡还是喝茶？
